thread:
rachel_fin: heads up - NOVA Corp disputed INV-2026-00610 (May). They were charged a $12,000 burst overage during onboarding and are asking for the charge to be waived.

ben_sales: spoke with AM. Onboarding stress test on 2026-05-04 through 05-06 caused the spike. Contract RWI-2026-NV section 3.2 allows discretionary one-time waivers for <=7 day onboarding bursts. Customer expected trial coverage.

emily_sre: infra confirms burst 2026-05-04T02:00Z -> 2026-05-06T18:00Z. Peak ~3.2x normal. No platform outage, just high test traffic. We captured request IDs and CPU/GPU traces.

tom_billing: invoice breakdown: reserved commit $30,000; burst overage $12,000; tax $2,640; total $44,640. Overage calc uses rate $0.06/overage-unit.

legal-bot: flagging contract clause 3.2 and onboarding waiver clause 9.1. Waiver permitted but must be documented in writing as a credit; cash refunds require exec approval.

rachel_fin: Accounting notes: one-time waiver reduces recognized revenue for May. Preference: apply as negative line (credit) on next invoice rather than issuing cash. Need GL reversal code and AR ticket.

ben_sales: customer asks for full waiver. AM proposes either full waive or 50% waive + 30d trial extension.

tom_billing: suggested compromise: 50% waiver ($6k) as credit + 30d trial extension. Precedent: AR-2987 last quarter. Finance supportive of credit route.

emily_sre: SLA credit not applicable here; SLO exceedance under 10% for month, so contract gives no SLA credit.

rachel_fin: I approve 50% waiver as credit. If customer insists on cash, escalate to CFO. GL memo: "Onboarding burst credit - NOVA RWI-2026-NV"; use 4305 reversal for $6,000.

billing-bot: created AR ticket AR-3399 and billing task TASK-8567. Assigned to tom_billing.

tom_billing: I'll post the negative line today, include overage unit calc (200k units -> $12k; waive 100k = $6k) and attach infra logs and incident refs INC-2026-201.

ben_sales: I'll send the customer the offer (50% credit + 30d extension) and attach infra traces. Will request written acceptance. If they push for full waiver, will escalate to CFO.

legal-bot: If customer wants cash refund, route to Legal+Finance; will require contract addendum and exec signoff.

rachel_fin: once posted, finance will adjust revenue for May. Tom, please include journal period 2026-05 and memo on the AR ticket.

ben_sales: thanks all. I'll update once NOVA responds.
